title: Plans and Timeline to Implement Busking Zones
what_it_is: Plans and Timeline to Implement Busking Zones

sections.label: New busking zones announced
sections.summary: MCCY announced in March 2020 that new busking zones would be introduced at the Singapore River and Ang Mo Kio.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: In March 2020, MCCY announced that we would introduce new busking zones at the Singapore River and Ang Mo Kio.

sections.label: COVID-19 delays busking zones
sections.summary: COVID-19 suspended busking, so the new zones could not be implemented, and NAC is working on an online system for busking access.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Unfortunately, the onset of COVID-19 in 2020 leading to a suspension of busking had meant that there was no opportunity for the new busking zones to be implemented and used by our buskers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: NAC has also been working on an online system to enhance access to busking locations and time for all buskers, in an equitable manner.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: NAC will share further details about this online system in the coming months.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The timeline for the implementation of these plans will have to take into consideration the prevailing COVID-19 situation.

sections.label: December 2020 busking pilots
sections.summary: In December 2020, NAC partnered Clarke Quay and *SCAPE for busking pilots over three weekends, which were well-received.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: In December 2020, NAC partnered Clarke Quay and *SCAPE to conduct busking pilots over three weekends which were well-received.

sections.label: NAC supports buskers' workshops
sections.summary: NAC supported the Buskers' Association through the Self-Employed Persons Grant for workshops, ending in live performances and a livestream.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: For example, in December last year, NAC supported the Buskers’ Association through the Self-Employed Persons Grant (SEPG) to organise a series of workshops for the busking community, culminating in live performances at Our Tampines Hub in December 2021 and via livestream in January 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: NAC is committed to improving our busking infrastructure and processes and will take into consideration the feedback it has received from buskers and other stakeholders, such as venue managers.
